note: The official 1999 Enchiridion and independently produced 1902 Breviarium agree on all 18 substantive words, their order and the complete collect boundary. The corpus follows the controlling Enchiridion's vocative punctuation while adopting the customary stress accents and ae ligatures directly witnessed by the Breviarium. The Breviarium abbreviation Dnum is expanded to Dominum, independently printed in full by the controlling witness. Oremus, response and speaker labels, rubrics and the surrounding Benedictio Mensae office are excluded rather than conflated with the prayer.
